sessions.notes:
Built an end-to-end ELT pipeline tracking live cryptocurrency market data:

- Python pipeline extracting top 50 coins from CoinGecko API with rate
  limit handling, derived metrics (volume spike detection, ATH bucketing,
  daily range %) and append-only loads to cloud Postgres (Supabase)
- dbt analytical layer: staging view + mart tables for latest prices and
  volume spike events, with schema tests and lineage documentation  
- React dashboard consuming Supabase REST API directly, displaying live
  prices, 24h/7d % changes, volume spike alerts and pipeline timestamp

Stack: Python · pandas · SQLAlchemy · dbt · Supabase (Postgres) · React

Buildiing live crypto dashboard that reads directly from Supabase mart tables and displays: 
Current prices and 24h change for all 50 coins
Volume spike alerts
Market cap rankings
building the analytical layer on top of raw crypto data using dbt — turning messy repeated snapshots into clean, queryable tables ready for webapp

Built a crypto market ETL pipeline in Python that extracts live price data 
for the top 50 coins from CoinGecko, transforms it with market signals 
(volume spike detection, ATH distance bucketing, daily range %), and loads 
timestamped snapshots into a cloud Postgres database (Supabase). 
Includes unit tests with pytest.
